name: AutoRKD EA
summary: AutoRKD EA is an automated trading system that uses the RKD (Random Key Derivation) custom oscillator indicator to generate buy and sell signals. It enters trades when the RKD indicator crosses key overbought and oversold threshold levels, operating systematically without manual intervention. The EA typically applies fixed lot sizing and includes basic stop-loss and take-profit mechanisms for trade management.
summary_zh: AutoRKD EA是一个基于RKD自定义振荡器指标生成买卖信号的自动化交易系统。当RKD指标穿越关键超买和超卖阈值水平时开仓交易，无需人工干预地系统化运行。该EA通常采用固定手数并包含基本的止损和止盈机制进行交易管理。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略核心基于RKD自定义振荡器指标，该指标类似于随机指标但采用不同的计算方法来衡量价格动量。入场条件为：当RKD指标从超卖区域向上穿越时产生买入信号，当RKD指标从超买区域向下穿越时产生卖出信号，典型的超买超卖阈值分别为70-80和20-30。出场条件依赖预设的止损和止盈水平，部分版本可能在RKD指标回到中性区域时平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，根据用户设定的参数确定每笔交易的手数，未发现基于账户余额或风险的动态仓位调整机制。资金管理方面，EA依赖止损止盈比率来控制单笔交易风险，但缺乏整体账户级别的风险控制如最大回撤限制或连续亏损保护。策略整体属于动量反转混合型，在超买超卖区域寻找反转信号入场。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on the RKD custom oscillator indicator, which is similar to the Stochastic oscillator but uses a different calculation method to measure price momentum. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when the RKD indicator crosses upward from the oversold zone, and a sell signal is generated when the RKD indicator crosses downward from the overbought zone, with typical overbought/oversold thresholds at 70-80 and 20-30 respectively. Exit conditions rely on preset stop-loss and take-profit levels, and some versions may close positions when the RKD indicator returns to the neutral zone. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach determined by user-set parameters, with no dynamic position adjustment based on account balance or risk percentage. Money management relies on stop-loss and take-profit ratios to control per-trade risk, but lacks account-level risk controls such as maximum drawdown limits or consecutive loss protection. The strategy overall is a momentum-reversal hybrid type, seeking reversal signals in overbought and oversold zones for entry.

parameters.description_en: Take profit in points; 0 disables take profit

pros: 基于自定义RKD振荡器，信号生成逻辑清晰，策略概念易于理解
采用固定手数交易，适合初学者使用，参数简单明了
支持止损止盈设置，提供了基本的单笔交易风险控制手段
pros_en: Based on custom RKD oscillator with clear signal generation logic and easy-to-understand strategy concept
Uses fixed lot sizing which is beginner-friendly with simple and straightforward parameters
Supports stop-loss and take-profit settings providing basic per-trade risk control mechanisms
cons: 固定手数缺乏动态仓位调整，无法根据账户规模和波动性自适应调整风险暴露
缺少账户级别的风险控制，如最大回撤限制、连续亏损保护或每日最大交易次数限制
RKD指标在强趋势行情中可能反复产生错误反转信号导致连续亏损
未检测是否有新K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓
cons_en: Fixed lot sizing lacks dynamic position adjustment, unable to adapt risk exposure based on account size and volatility
Lacks account-level risk controls such as maximum drawdown limits, consecutive loss protection, or daily maximum trade limits
RKD indicator may repeatedly generate false reversal signals during strong trending markets leading to consecutive losses
No evidence of new bar check mechanism, potentially opening multiple positions on the same bar
improvements: 增加动态仓位管理，根据账户余额百分比或ATR波动性自动调整手数
添加新K线检查机制，确保每根K线只产生一次交易信号避免重复开仓
增加账户级风险控制，包括最大回撤限制、连续亏损后的暂停交易和每日最大亏损限额
增加趋势过滤器（如均线方向），避免在强趋势中逆势开仓
improvements_en: Add dynamic position sizing that automatically adjusts lots based on account balance percentage or ATR volatility
Add new bar check mechanism to ensure only one trade signal per bar and avoid duplicate position openings
Add account-level risk controls including maximum drawdown limits, trading pause after consecutive losses, and daily maximum loss limits
Add a trend filter (e.g., moving average direction) to avoid counter-trend entries during strong trends

risk_points: 固定手数可能导致在账户增长时风险比例过低而在缩小时过高
缺少新K线检查可能导致同一K线上重复开仓放大风险
RKD振荡器在强趋势中反复产生反转信号可能导致连续亏损
risk_points_en: Fixed lot sizing may result in disproportionately low risk when account grows and excessively high risk when account shrinks
Lack of new bar check may cause duplicate position openings on the same bar amplifying risk
RKD oscillator repeatedly generating reversal signals during strong trends may lead to consecutive losses
